rdfs:label: orderedItems
rdfs:comment: The ordered members of an ActivityStreams OrderedCollection or OrderedCollectionPage — sequence is significant. A JSON-LD alias for `as:items` with an `@list` container, not a separate RDF property.
notes: `orderedItems` is a JSON-LD alias in the AS2 context for `as:items` with `@container: @list`. In RDF it is `as:items` whose value is an ordered rdf:List. It has no IRI of its own. Use on `OrderedCollection`/`OrderedCollectionPage`; for unordered collections use `as:items`. The JSON array order is the canonical order — for a chronologically sorted outbox, that's typically newest-first. Servers paginate ordered collections via `first`/`next` just like unordered ones. The example carries an inline context term so the array expands as an `@list`. It carries no owl:sameAs of its own: the RDF property is `https://www.w3.org/ns/activitystreams#items`, which the registry maps via `urn:solid:items`; this term only names the JSON-LD alias.

history.note: owl:sameAs -> as:items (orderedItems is the AS2 context's @list alias, no IRI of its own); domain -> urn:solid:OrderedCollection; example gets inline @list context. owl:sameAs moved to seeAlso (one registry term per upstream IRI).
